name: Andaz Savannah
positioning: Boutique hotel on Ellis Square in the heart of downtown Savannah's Historic District, with a pool terrace and an evening firepit
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to River Street, City Market and Forsyth Park
Guests who want a pool terrace with cabanas in the middle of downtown

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of downtown Savannah's Historic District, on Ellis Square.
The hotel is steps from the city's shopping, dining and historic sites, including River Street, City Market and Forsyth Park.
The rooms draw on downtown Savannah's distinctive style and its green squares.
Ellis Square King rooms have a view of Ellis Square.
Rooms include complimentary snacks and nonalcoholic beverages.
22 Square Restaurant serves modern Southern-inspired cuisine made from locally grown produce, from breakfast to late-night bites.
22 Square Bar has live music by local Savannah musicians on Saturday evenings.
The hotel welcomes dogs, with at least three days' advance notice.
The hotel has a fitness center.
The hotel has indoor and outdoor wedding venues.

highlights.text: The pool terrace is a spot for swimming or lounging right in downtown Savannah, with cabanas for more privacy.
Each evening there are s'mores around the firepit on the pool terrace.
The Andaz Deluxe Loft has a hosting kitchen, a king bed and a balcony overlooking the pool terrace or Ellis Square.
The Andaz Suite has a soaking tub, a wet bar and a balcony with views of downtown Savannah, the pool terrace or Ellis Square.

considerations.text: Self-parking is at the Whitaker Street Garage, open 24/7.
Savannah Hilton Head International Airport is 10.3 miles from the hotel.
All pet-friendly rooms are on the second floor.
